rows.qualification: Ph.D. in the relevant discipline and first class in the preceding degrees (Bachelor’s Degree onwards). Essential educational qualifications, experience, and credit points as per Schedule ‘E’ of the NIT Statute (Gazette of India, 24th July 2017).
rows.experience: As per Schedule ‘E’ of the NIT Statutes. Experience at Assistant Professor level with Academic Grade Pay ₹6000 or ₹7000 (Pay Level 10 or 11) is required as per MHRD letter dated 27th October 2017. Part-time, teaching assistant, or visiting/guest faculty experience is not counted. Regular experience of more than six months in eligible institutions/organizations will be considered.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Selected candidates for Assistant Professor Grade-I will be placed in Pay Level 12 of the Pay Matrix, with a pay range of ₹101,500/-pm to ₹167,400/-pm along with admissible allowances. Fresh appointees will be covered under the National Pension Scheme (NPS-2004) as per Government of India rules. Available facilities and incentives include Cumulative Professional Development Allowance (CPDA), provision for industrial consultancy, reimbursement of tuition fees for children up to XII standard, LTC, medical facilities, accommodation or HRA, seed grant up to ₹10,00,000/- for research activities, and reimbursement of telephone and data charges as per institute norms. All appointments in Pay Level 12 are made on probation for a period of one year.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SVNIT Assistant Professor Grade-I
content_sections.text: Visit the official online recruitment portal at https://svnitrec.samarth.edu.in/. Register and read the instructions carefully before filling out the online application form. Upload a recent color passport-size photograph with a clear front view without cap, scarf, and sunglasses. Complete all details including the credit point summary sheet and pay the required application fee online. Submit the online application on or before 30.11.2026 (5:00 p.m.). Download a copy of the completed online application form and credit point summary sheet. Send the printout of the downloaded application form, credit point summary sheet, and self-attested supporting documents (testimonials, age proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, fee proof, etc.) to the Deputy Registrar (Establishment), Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology, Ichchhanath, Dumas Road, Surat – 395 007, Gujarat on or before 07.12.2026 (5:00 p.m.).

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Age Proof 10th Mark sheet/Grade sheets and/or Certificate 12th Mark sheet/Grade sheets and/or Certificate Graduation mark sheet/Grade sheets and Certificate Post-graduation mark sheet/Grade sheets and certificate Ph.D. Degree/Certificate Caste/EWS and/or Disability certificate Ex-serviceman certificate, if applicable Experience certificate Documents in support of claimed credit points (research papers, patents, projects, achievements, experience, etc.) Proof of applicable application fee Any other relevant document

faq.question: Q1. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 17 vacancies for the Assistant Professor Grade-I post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 30.11.2026 up to 5:00 p.m.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date for receiving the hard copy of the application?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of the downloaded signed completed application at SVNIT Surat is 07.12.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Ph.D. in the relevant discipline and first class in preceding degrees from Bachelor’s degree onwards, along with qualifications as per Schedule ‘E’ of the NIT Statute.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay scale for Assistant Professor Grade-I?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive Pay Level 12 in the Pay Matrix, ranging from ₹101,500/-pm to ₹167,400/-pm along with admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q6. Who is exempted from paying the application processing fee?
faq.answer: SC, ST, PwD, female candidates, and faculty members of SVNIT, Surat are exempted from payment of processing fees.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for other candidates?
faq.answer: Other candidates are required to pay a non-refundable application processing fee of ₹1,000/- through the online portal.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the hard copy of the application be sent?
faq.answer: The hard copy must be sent to the Deputy Registrar (Establishment), Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology, Ichchhanath, Dumas Road, Surat – 395 007, Gujarat.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises scrutiny of applications and shortlisting, followed by a screening test, presentation, and/or interview.
